description: List open appointment times. Pass how many dogs and how many of them get a full groom — a groom takes about 2 hours vs 1 for a wash — so only starts the whole visit fits are returned. Returns a map of date (YYYY-MM-DD) to UTC ISO start times, plus days the owner is closed. Present times in Pacific Time (America/Los_Angeles). Defaults to the next 14 days.

dogs.description: How many dogs in the visit (1–4). Default 1.

end_date.description: Last day to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to start_date + 14 days.

grooms.description: How many of those dogs get a full groom. Default 0.

start_date.description: First day to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: get_available_slots
title: Get available appointment times
